snippet.title: Casting Whispers Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
My official announce trailer for Casting Whispers! Releases on Steam for PC in Fall 2025!

Casting Whispers is a first-person psychological horror game where you will need to use both sight and sound to keep yourself safe and further your investigation. You will need to close your eyes in-game to listen for clues in the environment, and keep a wary ear open for small changes in your environment. Things are not as they may seem and your senses may lie to you...

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406880/Casting_Whispers/
